title: Tron: Legacy
about: Sam Flynn goes looking for his missing father and is pulled into the digital world his dad created.
cue: Serve the snacks when Sam walks into his dad's old arcade.
faces: Sam, I want to see a real sunrise. But dinner first. My father says it helps.
